== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Hightower is a famous citadel and the primary headquarters for the [[Luminian Order]]. Located just outside the borders of the Capital, it serves as a massive fortification characterized by high walls made of gray-white [[stone]] that reach fifty feet in height. The structure originated as a cathedral featuring pointed peaks, high arches, and stained glass, but its most prominent feature is a central tower that rises from the cathedral's foundation. This weathered [[stone tower]] is topped with a massive glass orb held by bronze arms, which emits a powerful [[white light]] that acts as a second sun for the [[Luminian]] [[Guild]]. Historically, the site was established as a sanctuary for those escaping attacks from [[Elders]]. Over many centuries, the collective intent of people seeking refuge has created a protective [[aura]] and a pervasive sense of peace within the grounds. The citadel is also noted for its immense collection of books, housed in numerous towers that reach toward a cavernous ceiling. During the [[Elder War]], Hightower functioned as a significant fortification where humanity's most powerful warriors managed to trap a [[Great Elder]].}}
